subject: tau
title: FakeProvider replays scripted assistant-event streams; loop tests assert exact canonical event sequences
one_why: Provider-agnostic event replay at the loop seam makes event-protocol regressions fail with exact-sequence assertions, and the same fake ships in the package (tau_ai) so extension authors can test against it too.

subject: tau
title: Context accounting treats the latest provider usage receipt as authoritative for the prefix and estimates only the trailing delta
one_why: Trigger drift is bounded because billed reality anchors the estimate; stale receipts are invalidated when compaction or rewriting inserts a newer prefix message (:188-192), which most estimate-only harnesses get wrong.

subject: tau
title: Overflow-triggered compaction with an explicit will_retry signal when provider reports overflow
one_why: A turn lost to context overflow is recovered in-session (compact then retry once) instead of erroring out or silently truncating; failure of the recovery is surfaced as an event with error_message rather than swallowed.

subject: tau
title: tool_call hook blocks bind inside the loop, and a raising hook fails safe into a block
one_why: Extension exceptions cannot smuggle a tool call past the gate -- fail-closed default is tested; the gap vs crush's per-call-id grants is that the hook payload carries no tool-call id (api.py:466-467), so grants can't be scoped per call.

subject: tau
title: Anthropic cache breakpoints incl. last-tool breakpoint with a gateway-compat off-switch; OpenAI prompt-cache affinity key per session
one_why: The cache_control_on_tools flag exists because some Anthropic-protocol gateways accept cache_control everywhere except tools (anthropic.py:471-473) -- hard-won compat detail most ports miss.

subject: tau
title: Product surfaces fuse despite a clean core: tui/app.py 8,642 LOC and session.py 5,095 LOC
evidence: src/tau_coding/tui/app.py (8642 wc -l), src/tau_coding/session.py:405+ (CodingSession owns entries, compaction, provider switching, extensions)
one_why: tau shows the port's disease: the pi core discipline transferred, but the app layer accreted past the errata's 5k docking line (worse than pi's own 6.8k interactive-mode.ts), capping architecture at 7.

subject: tau
title: No default tool-approval layer at all: bash execs directly; enforcement is opt-in via extension hooks, with unusually explicit honesty about it
evidence: src/tau_coding/tools.py:627-646 (create_subprocess_shell, no gate), src/tau_coding/project_trust.py:1-5 ('deliberately not a ... sandbox'), src/tau_coding/tui/project_trust.py:122
one_why: Same posture as pi's rung-6 (nothing underneath, no illusions) -- the disclaimer language at project_trust.py:4,:662 and in the TUI prompt is the model for honest security-posture docs; the finding is the absence, not any misrepresentation.
